paragraphs: The 330i has been a mainstay of the BMW 3 Series petrol range across two generations. The F30/F31 generation (2015–2019) introduced the B48 — a 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine that replaced the earlier N20. The G20/G21 generation (2019–2024 UK) continued with the B48, updated with improvements including a revised timing chain design. The 330i was discontinued in the UK following the 2024 range update, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: The 330i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol engine fitted to the 330i from 2015 to 2024 (UK). The B48 is BMW's modular engine family, generally regarded as reliable with no significant widespread defect pattern compared to its predecessor. We replace timing chain components, bearings and gaskets as standard on every B48 rebuild, inspecting each component individually and replacing where wear is detected.
